paite: TOUPA ka it ahi, ka aw leh ka ngetnate angaihkhiak ziak in.
heading: Sihna A Kipan Ahotdammi In Pathian Aphat
english: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

paite: Kei lam a abil ahon doh ziak in ka damsung teng in amah ka sam ding hi.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

paite: Sihna khauhualte'n hon vial a, Sheol natnate'n hon man a, mangbatna leh lungkhamna ka na tuak hi.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

paite: Huaitak in TOUPA min ka sam a; "Aw TOUPA, hehpih in ka hinna humbit in," chi in.
english: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

paite: TOUPA mihehpih theitak leh diktattak ahi a; ahi, i Pathian uh milainat theitak ahi.
english: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

paite: TOUPA'N mimawlte ahumbit nak a; hihniam in ka om a, ama'n hon hondamta hi.
english: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

paite: Ka hinna aw, na khawlna ah kikta in; TOUPA'N na tung ah hoihtak in ahihta ngal a.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

paite: Ka hinna sihna a pan, ka mitte khitui a pan, ka khete pukna a pan na humbitta hi.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

paite: Mihing gam ah TOUPA ma ah ka vak ding hi.
english: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

paite: Ka gingta a, thu ka gen ding, ahi, nakpitak a hihgim in ka om hi.
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

paite: Ka lungvai in, mi tengteng zuau ahi uh, ka na chita mawk hi.
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

paite: Ka tung a athil hoih hih tengteng ziak in TOUPA kiang ah bang ahia ka piak thuk sam ding?
english: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

paite: Hotdamna nou ka la ding a, TOUPA min ka sam ding hi.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

paite: Ka thuchiamte TOUPA kiang ah ka tangtun ding, ahi amite ma ah.
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

paite: Amisiangthoute sihna TOUPA muh in manphapi ahi.
english: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.

paite: TOUPA aw, na sikha ka hi, na sikha, na sikhanu tapa ka hi; na hon henna na sutta hi.
english: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

paite: Kipahthu genna kithoihnate ka hon lan ding a, TOUPA min ka sam ding hi.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

paite: Ka thuchiamte TOUPA kiang ah ka tangtun ding, ahi, amite tengteng ma ah;
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

paite: TOUPA' inn huangsung intual ah, Jerusalem aw, na laitak ah ka tangtun ding hi. TOUPA phat un.
english: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
